create_mlp_params: create MLP network parameters from layer sizes and a PRNG key using make_mlp_params
create_cnn_params: create CNN network parameters with conv and FC layers from layer sizes and a PRNG key using make_cnn_params
test_toy_verification: test a toy neural network verification instance by generating it with make_toy_verif_instance
convert_conv_to_mlp: convert a convolution layer into an equivalent MLP layer using make_mlp_layer_from_conv_layer
convert_cnn_to_mlp_verif: convert a CNN verification instance into an equivalent MLP verification instance using make_mlp_verif_instance_from_cnn
